headline: One API for TYPO3.
headline_accent: Write it once, use it everywhere.
lead: The Action API turns a typed PHP method into a feature that the TYPO3 backend, external applications and AI agents can use: validated, documented and secured, without writing a single controller.

channels.title: AI agents
channels.text: MCP tools, over HTTP or stdio

facts.title: Write once
facts.text: One PHP method serves the backend, integrations and AI agents.

facts.title: Typed and validated
facts.text: JSON Schema derived from PHP types; input and output are checked.

facts.title: Secure by design
facts.text: Runs as a backend user; scopes limit what an app may do.

facts.title: AI-ready
facts.text: A built-in MCP server offers every action as a tool.
